description: Comprehensive benchmark cases package containing: Images, Simple Image VLM answers, Model Spatial Scene Graphs, Ground-Truth Small Scene Graphs, Small SG Direct QA results, and Small SG CoT QA results.

cases.analysis: Direct Image VLM identified 'black sign'. On Small SG, Direct QA suffered from spatial confusion ('air conditioner'), while CoT hit token exhaustion (1024 tokens) analyzing bus mirror relations.

cases.question: What is on the plate that is to the right of the carrots?

cases.analysis: Direct Image VLM recognized plate, sandwich, pickle, and salad, but missed the fork. In contrast, BOTH Direct QA and CoT QA on the Small Scene Graph correctly retrieved 'fork'.
